units.source_text: 即使是毫不足道的衰老之人，

en.t: Even an old person of no great importance,

units.source_text: 面临削发出家之际，

en.t: when facing the moment of shaving the head and entering religious life,

units.source_text: 也不免方寸动乱，悲从中来。

en.t: could not help having the heart thrown into confusion, with sorrow rising from within.

units.source_text: 何况藤壶皇后青春鼎盛，

en.t: How much more so, then, when Empress Fujitsubo was in the full bloom of youth,

units.source_text: 预先并无一言，突然遁世，

en.t: and without saying a word beforehand, suddenly withdrew from the world.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王安得不放声大哭！

en.t: How could Prince Hyobukyo not burst into loud sobs!

units.source_text: 其他参与法会的人，看见周围气象悲切而庄严，

en.t: The others who attended the service, seeing the atmosphere around them so sorrowful and solemn,

units.source_text: 也无不泪满襟袖而归去。

en.t: all went home with tears soaking their collars and sleeves.

units.source_text: 桐壶院的许多皇子，回想藤壶皇后昔日荣华，

en.t: Many princes of the Kiritsubo Retired Emperor thought back on Empress Fujitsubo's former splendor,

units.source_text: 大家感慨悲叹，都来慰问。

en.t: and moved to sorrowful sighs, they all came to offer consolation.

units.source_text: 只有源氏大将，散会后依旧枯坐席上，

en.t: Only General Genji remained sitting lifelessly in his place after the gathering had ended,

units.source_text: 一言不发，心中茫然若失。

en.t: saying not a word, his heart dazed as though he had lost something.

units.source_text: 但深恐旁人怪他为何如此悲伤，

en.t: But he deeply feared that others would wonder why he was so grief-stricken,

units.source_text: 便于兵部卿亲王退出后前来慰问。

en.t: and so after Prince Hyobukyo withdrew, he came forward to offer consolation.

units.source_text: 此时众人渐次散去，四周寂静。

en.t: By then the people had gradually dispersed, and all around was quiet.

units.source_text: 众侍女拭着眼泪，群集在各处。

en.t: The many ladies-in-waiting wiped their tears and gathered here and there.

units.source_text: 月明如昼，雪光映目，庭前景色凄清。

en.t: The moon was bright as day, the light on the snow dazzled the eyes, and the garden before them looked bleak and pure.

units.source_text: 源氏大将对此夜色，沉思往事，不堪悲恸。

en.t: Facing this night scene, General Genji sank into thoughts of the past and could not bear his grief.

units.source_text: 强自镇静，命侍女传言问道：“何故如此突然下了决心？”

en.t: Forcing himself to be calm, he had a lady-in-waiting carry his words and ask, "Why did you make this decision so suddenly?"

units.source_text: 皇后照例遣王命妇答道：“我早有此志，并非今日始下决心。

en.t: As usual, the Empress sent Omyobu to reply, "I have long had this intention; I did not first decide it today.

units.source_text: 所以不早说者，深恐人言骚扰，使我心乱耳。”

en.t: The reason I did not speak of it sooner was that I greatly feared people's talk would disturb me and unsettle my heart."

units.source_text: 此时帘内侍女云集，行动起居、衣衫窸窣之声，历历可闻。

en.t: At that moment, the ladies-in-waiting were gathered thickly inside the blinds, and the sounds of their movements and rustling robes could be heard clearly.

units.source_text: 惊恐悲叹之声，亦时时泄露帘外。

en.t: Their voices of alarm, fear, sorrow, and lament also leaked out beyond the blinds from time to time.

units.source_text: 源氏大将想道：不可早说，确是有理。

en.t: General Genji thought: it truly made sense that she could not have spoken of it sooner.

units.source_text: 便觉无限悲伤。

en.t: At that, he felt boundless sorrow.
